dogecoin.text: Can't go into this game without understanding which tokens do what. Randomly picking something, cuz it's cheap, doesn't mean it'll be the next $DOGE or even behave like that coin. Gotta do your Due Diligence, learn what tech is behind what's piqued your interest.

$VTHO had an all time high of $0.043, currently it's at $0.02. It reached that peak because it's on Binance and really cheap and folks are looking for the next $DOGE. It is not the next $DOGE. $VTHO is a gas coin, it gets burned with the exchange of $VET. You wanna buy $VET.
